title: Project Organica v0.11.0 — the frozen Organica 1 engine and the evidence produced under it
description: The archival release of Project Organica. `organica/` is the engine: a memory store, a sleep service that grows typed structural candidates across cycles, and the laws the engine is meant to satisfy. The engine is frozen at v0.9.0 and is not modified by later work; the engine files under this version are byte-identical to the v0.9.0 tag apart from the package version string, and tests/test_v1_freeze.py fails if one differs. The release carries that engine together with the evidence produced under it: the belief-revision comparison against simple baselines (Phase K), the plasticity-coherence sweep (Phase L), the capacity-1,000 confirmatory test of the frozen functional-structure study, the acquisition-benchmark audits, the Gate 13 relation-ranking analyses, the formation-versus-utilization campaign, and the candidate-membership audit that reconstructed that campaign's candidate population. The engine uses only the Python standard library.
notes: Archived from the master commit recorded as software_commit in the deposit manifest (DEPOSIT-MANIFEST.json / MANIFEST.json). No v0.11.0 tag or GitHub release has been cut, so the commit SHA is the identifier; v0.9.0 remains the archival reference for the engine alone, and the latest published release is v0.10.0. Organica 1 is frozen: the engine under this version is byte-identical to the v0.9.0 tag apart from the package version string, and none of the research package modifies the engine.
